posts.excerpt: If you’re arriving in Halifax on a cruise ship and have just one day to explore the city, you’re in luck. Halifax is one of those rare cruise destinations where you can step off the ship and be right in the middle of a real, walkable city, with the waterfront, historic sites, museums, restaurants, shops and parks all within relatively easy reach.
